text:
Maya (docs): Quick heads-up 1 I'm opening a small docs refresh to the 'Hello Quickstart' that consolidates auth examples and adds a migration appendix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912. Can folks sanity-check the snippets?

Ben (eng): On it. Is the migration appendix mapping from `client.chat.*` to `client.responses.*` or do we keep both?

Maya (docs): We'll show both side-by-side for one screen, then recommend responses API as primary. Also renaming env var examples to RW_API_KEY (long-lived) and RW_EPHEM (ephemeral) to avoid confusion.

Alexa (devex): I'll update the quickstart generator templates to emit the new imports and responses usage. Also will add a small note about Node 20 vs older CI images.

Sam (qa): I'll run the sample container and check the /api/hello route. Can you paste the exact run command?

Maya (docs): From the PR notes:
```
# build and run
docker build -t rw-hello:docs .
docker run -e RW_EPHEM=eyJ... -p 3000:3000 rw-hello:docs
# smoke
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/hello | jq
```
If using long-lived key: `-e RW_API_KEY=sk_live_...`

Ben (eng): Found one leftover snippet using `cache: true` in the batching sample. Runtime expects `sessionCache: 'auto'`. I'll push that minor fix.

Jules (solutions): Heads-up for partner workshops: some customers still refer to RW_TOKEN in internal playbooks. Could we add a short note mapping old env names to new ones?

Maya (docs): Yes, migration table added in appendix (old -> new). Also added a short troubleshooting checklist (ports, node version, env var names).

Alexa (devex): Pushed generator patch and a small linter fix (missing semicolon in example).

merge-bot: CI started for branch docs/quickstart-refresh-912 1 build 5602 queued.

Sam (qa): When I ran the container w/ RW_EPHEM the app returned 500 at /auth/callback if REDWOOD_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID isn't set. Recommend we document required redirect and client id envs.

Ben (eng): Good catch. I'll add a guard to the callback route to return a friendly 400 + doc link instead of stacktrace.

Maya (docs): Done 1 added explicit env example to the README and a link to the migration appendix.

Alexa (devex): CI lint step failed on examples/hello/app.js (trailing comma). Fixed in branch.

merge-bot: build 5602 failed (docs-lint).

Maya (docs): Fixed trailing comma and clarified the OAuth flow wording. Also added a short CLI snippet for ephemeral token generation: `tools/auth-exchange --ttl 600`.

merge-bot: build 5603 passed 1 preview at https://deploy-preview-912.redwood.dev

Jules (solutions): Preview looks good. Small wording nit in the migration table: change "chat->responses" to "chat.* -> responses.generate" for clarity.

Ben (eng): Done. One final runtime note: the sample's batch config used `maxBatchSize: 64` which is fine, but we should call out latency trade-offs in the appendix. Added a one-liner.

Maya (docs): Thanks all. If no objections I'll merge this afternoon. Target: update quickstart generator release after merge.

Alexa (devex): No objections, merging afterwards I will publish the generator patch
